messages:
rebecca (People Ops): FYI @emma.li submitted resignation this morning, last day 2026-04-02. Need coordination: access cutover, final pay, COBRA window, equipment return, and a 30–60 min exit interview. :wave:
emma.li: thanks — correct, leaving to take a role elsewhere. Happy to help with KT. I requested email forwarding for 90 days to keep client threads intact, is that feasible?
nick (Eng): tagging infra — we should snapshot Emma's active runs and make a clean handoff. Can we get a list of repos and service accounts she owns?
rebecca (People Ops): Nick — can you post the list by EOD? Also @it-support-bot please open a ticket for laptop pickup or ship-back. Emma is in Amsterdam for the next two weeks.
it-support-bot: ticket created: #IT-6821 — Schedule pickup/ship-back (owner: it-ops). Shipping label option added. ETA to Emma: 5–7 business days.
payroll-bot: Reminder: final paycheck cut on employee's last day (2026-04-02). Submit any outstanding expense reports by 2026-03-29 to be included. COBRA notice will be emailed within 7 business days of termination.
rebecca (People Ops): Quick question on email forwarding: security ok with forwarding for 90 days? Copying @olivia. Also need confirmation on license transfers (JetBrains, Figma) and AWS role ownership transfer.
olivia (Security): We can allow forwarding for business emails only, must exclude HR/payroll folders and any PII. Need a signed acknowledgement from Emma for data-handling during forwarding. Also require SSO disable after 90 days.
emma.li: I can sign the acknowledgement. For licenses — I don't need Figma access after last day but we need to transfer JetBrains and the personal license reimbursement details. I'll add repo OWNERS and a short KT doc.
nick (Eng): Repo/ownership list: `infra/kv-cache`, `runtime/kernels`, `tools/deploy`. I created a short TODO in `infra/README/offboard-emma.md` — please review. Also we should rotate any long-lived tokens she minted.
rebecca (People Ops): Thanks. @sam (Recruiting) can you start hiring req and set up interviews? Prefer internal ref first.
sam (Recruiting): On it — opening req for Staff ML Engineer today. Will coordinate interview panel and block time for overlap with Emma for pair-KT.
mike (Facilities): For EU shipping: please fill in return form here: https://internal.redwood/it/returns — we can schedule a carrier pickup on 2026-04-03.
rebecca (People Ops): Action items roundup: 1) Nick: list of service accounts + rotate tokens (due 2026-03-27). 2) IT: ship label + pickup (it-ops). 3) Payroll: final pay + COBRA notice (payroll-bot). 4) Security: signoff on forwarding + acknowledgement template (olivia). 5) Recruiting: open req + schedule handoff pairing (sam). 6) Emma: KT doc + OWNERS entries. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
olivia (Security): I'll post the short acknowledgement template in this thread by EOD and cc Legal.
payroll-bot: COBRA timeline: enrollment window 60 days from termination notice receipt. Email subject line: "Redwood COBRA: Action Required".
emma.li: Appreciate the support. I'll prepare the KT doc and a list of outstanding tasks. Can we also get email alias `emma+handoff@redwood.com` forwarded to `teamruntime@redwood.com` (business only)?
rebecca (People Ops): That works as long as Security approves. Olivia — ok to forward `emma@` -> `teamruntime@` per the constraints above?
olivia (Security): Approve with conditions: no HR/payroll messages, disable after 90 days, and include signed acknowledgement. I'll coordinate with IT to set up the alias rule.
nick (Eng): One more: production DB access — Emma has a read-only role and a short-lived admin token for incident runs. We'll revoke admin token on 2026-04-02, keep read-only until 2026-05-01 for the agreed overlap.
emergency (it-support-bot): command suggestion: `scripts/deprovision --user emma.li --revoke-admin --schedule 2026-04-02` (please confirm before running).
rebecca (People Ops): Perfect. Let's not run anything until we confirm with Emma. Thanks everyone — I'll compile an offboarding checklist and post the finalized timeline here by EOD.
